question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death from aging?
premises: The practice involves non-eating by day
The concern is death associated with age
inference: By abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death from aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is unusual; taken as going beyond or overcoming death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from old age.
